rule.statement: A party is not duty bound to follow the provisions of section 21 before issuing the letter of termination if the agreement between the parties states otherwise.
rule.supporting_quote: The parties to this Agreement hereby agree that provisions of Part II of Finance Leasing Act 56 of 2000 will not apply to this Agreement other than provisions contained in sections 11, 16, 22, and 24 save and except as stated in this Agreement.
